star_audit.method: independent oracle (scratch Python, not committed): ICRS to galactic, nearest committed row per tier, compared with literature RA/Dec/distance/V
star_audit.Sirius: quick row at 8.60 ly, 0.00 ly off expected position; V -1.44 (hip_main verbatim, literature -1.46), teff 9597 K (literature ~9900-10000), flags 8, no bright duplicate. OK
star_audit.alpha_Cen_A: quick (CNS5 system row 3627) 4.321 ly, V -0.01, teff 5550 K, flags 8. OK
star_audit.alpha_Cen_B: bright row HIP 71681: 4.321040 ly vs A 4.321040 ly (same system distance, not the 4.09 ly HIP2 parallax); 3D separation 0.000401 ly = 19.12 arcsec from A (about 19 arcsec expected at the 1991.25 epoch the override uses); V 1.35 (literature 1.33), teff 5059 K (literature ~5200). OK
star_audit.Arcturus: quick, 36.72 ly (literature 36.7), V -0.05, teff 4302 K (literature ~4290). Excellent; propagation to CNS5 epoch matters here (pm 2.3 arcsec/yr).
star_audit.Vega: quick, 25.04 ly, V 0.03, teff 9714 K (literature ~9600). OK; absent from bright (matched).
star_audit.Rigel: bright, 862.8 ly (HIP2 plx 3.78 mas; literature ~860), V 0.18 (hip_main; literature 0.13), teff 10,120 K vs literature ~12,100 (cool: dwarf teffFromBV on a supergiant). Position within 2.9 ly of the J2000 expectation (distance difference only).
star_audit.Canopus: bright, 309.2 ly (literature ~310), V -0.62 (hip_main; SIMBAD -0.74), teff 8070 K vs ~7400 (warm: dwarf calibration, bv 0.15).
star_audit.Betelgeuse: bright, 497.9 ly (HIP2; modern estimates ~500-550), V 0.45, teff 3590 K (literature ~3600). OK.
star_audit.Polaris: bright, 432.6 ly (literature ~433), V 1.97 (1.98), teff 5815 K vs ~6000. OK.
star_audit.verdict: Positions and distances agree with Hipparcos and literature to the data's precision; V agrees with hip_main; teff errors up to about 2000 K for supergiants (Rigel 17% cool) are the declared dwarf-calibration limit.

mutation_audit.run: 33 mutants of sim/tools/bright.ail, each run through make bright-test (strict VM + fixtures)

survived.mutant: guard-ignore-missing: drop the o.missing term in owner() (bright.ail:139)
survived.assessment: REAL GAP: no fixture with two missing rows sharing one HIP id. The real-data quick tier would change, but only make catalogue-verify would notice.

survived.mutant: guard-onesided: 2-mag window checked on one side only in owner() (bright.ail:139)
survived.assessment: REAL GAP: the |G-V| < 2 window is exercised on one side only.

survived.mutant: gcns-radius-2 / gcns-radius-half: 1 arcsec match radius changed to 2 arcsec or 0.5 arcsec (bright.ail:123)
survived.assessment: REAL GAP: no fixture at the radius boundary; the 1 arcsec number is untested.

survived.mutant: epoch-keep-1991: kept (rule a) rows built at 1991.25 instead of 2016.0 (bright.ail:168)
survived.assessment: REAL GAP: epoch propagation of kept rows is not asserted, though J2016.0 is declared. (The GCNS-match epoch and the override epoch mutants were killed.)

survived.mutant: bv-none-keep: no-B-V stars kept with bv 0.5 instead of excluded (bright.ail:168)
survived.assessment: REAL GAP: no unit test for the declared B-V exclusion; only the real-data count (7 excluded) would show it.

survived.mutant: flag-oor: flag 16 for B-V outside the teffFromBV table dropped (bright.ail:133)

survived.assessment: minor; a Plx of 0 would be refused rather than skipped
minor; covered at the extract level
equivalent on the fixture data (alpha Cen row epoch is 1991.25; the extra pattern arm duplicates the `_` arm). Not counted as gaps.

mutation_audit.killed_list: shared-HIP guard (owner always true, window ignored, 2-mag to 20 and 0.5), GCNS 2-mag (20, one-sided, no gate), GCNS epoch, epoch propagation off and sign flipped, RA proper-motion term, override own parallax / epoch 2016 / allowed CNS5 row, cuts V<7.5, V<6, V<=7, no plx cut, CNS5 match skipped, flag 8, fill gate, fill V.

deviation_verdicts.Sirius V -1.44: ACCEPT. hip_main verbatim is the pinned source; literature -1.46 comes from a later reduction. Documented. Confirmed in the committed quick bin.
deviation_verdicts.shared-HIP 2-mag rule: ACCEPT. Sound (Aldebaran A filled, faint companions not) and 11 shared rows stay missing, listed in the build log. Test coverage of the rule is partial (two survivors above).
deviation_verdicts.bright rows at J2016.0, alpha Cen B at 1: ACCEPT. Consistent with the CNS5 system row, giving the correct 19 arcsec separation at the same distance. Add a fixture assertion for the J2016.0 epoch of kept rows.
deviation_verdicts.no-B-V stars excluded: ACCEPT as a data decision (7 stars, listed in the sidecar's build output via count_excluded). The rule needs a unit test.
deviation_verdicts.new bright_main.ail: ACCEPT. Upstream VM bug reported; catalogue_main is untouched in behaviour, medium bytes identical.
deviation_verdicts.std/map to sorted array: ACCEPT. Required by strict bytecode; verified under strict VM = interpreter.
deviation_verdicts.files outside the plan's list: ACCEPT. All are justified (loader flag constants, stats, parity script); star_catalogue.gd change small.
deviation_verdicts.giants too cool: ACCEPT for R1 with a follow-up. Rigel 10,120 K vs ~12,100 K, Canopus warm. Needs a luminosity-class-aware colour table before M1.5b visuals judge star colours; the package owns the maths, so file against sunholo/relativity.
deviation_verdicts.LOC 805 over cap 650: ACCEPT with a note. Bulk is tests and fixtures; the pure core is 185 lines.

recommendations: Add fixtures killing the five real survivors: two missing rows with one HIP id; companion G on the faint side of the window; 1 arcsec boundary (0.9 and 1.1 arcsec); kept-row epoch is 2016.0; a V < 7 star with no B-V is excluded and counted.
